bio: Indulge in a delicious Afternoon Tea at the elegant 4* Crewe Hall Hotel. Expect picturesque surroundings with a beautiful grassland as you travel up the majestic tree lined drive, before enjoying the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served in the opulent surroundings of the Oak Parlour, a relaxing space that features a decorated ceiling and has retained original panelling that survived the great fire of 1866. This historic room is entirely wainscoted in oak & it was from here that the Steward carried out his Master's business.  The menu features a modern take on the classic British Afternoon Tea, with a selection of sandwiches, scones and assortment of sweet treats.  Crewe Hall is found in the heart of the Cheshire countryside within a short distance from a number of attractions including the Crewe Heritage Centre, Hack Green Nuclear Bunker, Wedgewood Experience & Trentham Gardens.
